plan: Given my value of $15, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while minimizing the risk of overpaying. Rational bidders will bid below their value to ensure a profit if they win. A bid around $14.9 balances winning chances and profit margin, assuming others bid close to their value.

I aim to outbid others without exceeding my value. Bidding $35.9 ensures I win if others bid close to their values below mine.
